title: Estimator / Quote / Order Snapshot Cleanup
implementation_summary: Added Decimal-backed worker-rate snapshot normalization so quote/order worker_rate_per_m saves the two-decimal user-facing wage instead of binary float drift.
Routed estimator quote save, Start Party Order, and estimator-origin market-run quote/order writes through the normalized worker-rate snapshot value.
Added a shared estimator draft storage key/parser and changed quote restore to warn before overwriting another recoverable local estimator draft.
Removed the silent draft-to-accepted quote transition and exposed only draft-to-sent and sent-to-accepted/rejected UI actions.

evidence: npx vitest run __tests__/estimator.test.ts __tests__/width-field.test.ts passed with 33 tests.
Estimator-origin quote/order worker-rate snapshots are normalized before persistence.
Start Party Order normalizes explicit workerRatePerM inputs before accepted quote creation and shared quote-to-order conversion.
No commercial read-model or commercial formula code was intentionally changed.
Accepted quotes saved after this patch store normalized worker_rate_per_m.
The existing convert_accepted_quote_to_order RPC copies estimator_quotes.worker_rate_per_m into orders.worker_rate_per_m, so newly converted orders inherit the normalized snapshot.
npx vitest run __tests__/batch10-estimator-quote-order-snapshots.test.ts passed and verifies the normalized quote/order write paths.
Supervisor-visible order worker_rate_per_m is sourced from the order snapshot, which is now written from normalized estimator/quote paths.
No assignment or supervisor production logic was intentionally changed.
Quote restore now parses the same autosave key used by the estimator and prompts when a different recoverable draft exists.
The dialog offers Keep draft and Overwrite draft choices before replacing localStorage.
Same-source quote restore remains direct because it is not another draft collision.
npx vitest run __tests__/batch10-estimator-quote-order-snapshots.test.ts passed and verifies the collision helper and UI prompt wiring.
updateQuoteStatus no longer special-cases draft to accepted through a silent sent write.
Allowed transitions remain draft -> sent and sent -> accepted/rejected.
Quote History exposes Mark Sent for drafts and Accept/Reject only for sent quotes.
npx vitest run __tests__/batch10-estimator-quote-order-snapshots.test.ts passed and verifies server/UI transition wiring.
